title: Retained-art design briefs
pathConvention: All body and artwork paths are relative to the Anima project root; bodyAnchor identifies the full canonical body or its explicit maintained full-body reference.
scope: Complete design briefs with distinct recorded-request, returned-revision, review-association, unknown-submission and independent-specification roles. bodySha256 identifies the displayed brief including its final newline, not necessarily the submitted request. Text retention grants no input, layer, motion, runtime or rights permission.

collections.title: Literary moments and complete character scenes
collections.purpose: Direct a specific character's attention, activity, object, support and whole-room light as one moment; keep different poses and versions distinct.

collections.title: Complete rooms, atmosphere and relighting
collections.purpose: Preserve camera, furnishing and one coherent light field across room and figure. An illustrated setting remains fictional and supplies no navigation geometry.

collections.title: Same-canvas layers, masks and contact registration
collections.purpose: Understand exact canvas separation, solid selected matter, honest air gaps, contact ownership and background continuity before choosing a compatible current original.

collections.title: Planning, interruption and local recovery
collections.purpose: Make original, trial and current state perceptible, retain the exact draft and let acknowledgement-unknown, cancellation and recovery lead to different real actions.

collections.title: Notes, persona agreements and everyday creations
collections.purpose: Preserve a person's independent words and choices while source revisions, character agreements, stories and useful creations keep their distinct owners and adoption steps.

collections.title: Instruments and causal creations
collections.purpose: Keep directly playable parameters, visible physical mechanism, sound and explanation causally linked in the same creation rather than treating a composed picture as a working instrument.

collections.title: Reading, mathematics and continuous conversation
collections.purpose: Protect the same original page, exact selection, mathematical meaning, one current draft and direct manipulation while work enters and leaves the conversation.

collections.title: Portraits, cats and small companion forms
collections.purpose: Keep each character's identity and agency legible at small scale, with one complete supported horizontal form and deliberate docking of that same sprite.

records.title: Anon Chihaya · she lays out what she wants to do and leaves a corner for you to rewrite. She still genuinely wants to make one more case for the option she most anticipates, yet leaves an open part of her own arrangement that you can change. A small spirited glint remains within her seriousness; her gaze is clear, and a beautiful arrangement is not presented as an already made decision. At this moment she gently lifts her eyes from the blank corner of the small notebook on her lap toward the off-camera companion, brows slightly raised and lips drawn in a little, ready to hear your thoughts first. Keep the lively specificity of Anon, a thoughtful hopeful pause rather than a broad generic smile, theatrical sadness or a presentation pose. There is only one visible person; the companion is off camera

records.title: Rāna Kaname · “Where the story bends.” You have been telling a small event with care. Rāna suddenly notices a side branch that has little to do with your conclusion. Her follow-up would be short, yet it quietly takes the story somewhere else. Twilight leaves room for this unplanned exchange. She has her own precise curiosity, and neither of you must arrange every sentence into an answer. There is a brief glint in her unequal eyes and a tiny, private hint of delight at a detail someone else missed, then a relaxed direct gaze. Avoid a broad performance of playfulness, a stock reassuring smile, or making dusk automatically melancholic. She is candid and observant
